title: Approval of Right-of-Entry with Theatre/Palisades for Laydown and Staging
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Administrative Officer
  Approval of Right-of-Entry with Theatre/Palisades for Laydown and Staging
  for Pacific Palisades Recovery at 941 Temescal Canyon Road,
  Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles County, California 90272. The proposed
  Agreement is for a term of three years with a monthly consideration of
  $10,800 for a total consideration of $388,800.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15303(d).

3. Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Agreement No. 47964 for Customer Service Market Research
  and Consulting Services – Pacific Consulting Group, Inc. dba
  PCG Enterprises, Inc. This Agreement is for a term of five years with an
  amount not to exceed $5,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15060(c)(3) and 15378(b)(5).

4. Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Amendment No.1 to Agreement 47706 for a Queue Management
  System with Q Matic Corporation. The Amendment will increase the current
  amount of $1,200,000 by $97,200 to a new not to exceed amount of
  $1,297,200. The term of the Agreement will remain unchanged and will
  expire on January 31, 2027.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections15060 (c)(3) and 15378 (b)(5).

5. Recommended by Office of the Chief Safety Officer
  Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 47783 with Intelex
  Technologies, ULC. The Amendment adds a two-year extension to the
  current three-year term for a total term to five years and an additional
  $1,257,000 to the $850,000 amount bringing the new not to exceed amount
  to $2,107,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

6. Recommended by Office of the Chief Strategy and Sustainability Officer
  Approval of Figueroa Junction-Halldale Receiving Station Transmission Line
  Right-of-Way No. 19 Covenant to Restrict Use of Property Environmental
  Restriction with Department of Toxic Substances Control. It is expected that
  there will be up to $10,000 per year in administrative and labor costs
  associated with complying with the Land Use Covenant.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  City Council approval is required.

7. Recommended by Office of the Chief Strategy and Sustainability Officer
  Approval of Resolution for Granada Trunk Line Replacement Project and
  Adoption of the Mitigated Negative Declaration in Accordance with the
  California Environmental Quality Act. The Project is estimated to cost
  $200,000,000 and is budgeted in the Water Fund through Fiscal Year
  2030/2031.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

 8. Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Authorization to Issue up to $493.485 Million of Water System
  Revenue Bonds Under Resolution Nos. 5097 and 5098. The proposed
  Resolutions will authorize the issuance of up to $493.485 Million of fixed-rate,
  tax-exempt Water System Revenue Bonds, 2026 Series B to refinance
  certain outstanding Water System Revenue Bonds, 2017 Series A
  (Water 2017A Bonds), and to pay the related costs of the debt issuance.
  The refunding of the Water 2017A Bonds is being issued to realize debt
  service savings.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

9. Recommended by Retirement Plan
  Approval of Resolution Approving the Election Rules and Regulations for
  Elected Active Members of the Board of Administration of the Water and
  Power Employees’ Retirement Plan for the Terms May 1, 2027 through
  April 30, 2030. The cost of the election, as estimated by the City Clerk’s
  Office, is approximately $51,000. The newly elected contributing members to
  the Retirement Board will serve from May 1, 2027 through April 30, 2030.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

10. Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Agreement No. 47981 for Seawater Desalination Feasibility
  Study with CDM Smith Inc. The Agreement is for a term of 18 months and an
  amount not to exceed $500,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

11. Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Agreement No. 47988 for SAMS Software Training and Support
  NJBSoft, LLC. The Agreement is for a for a term of three years and an
  amount not to exceed $300,025.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(2).

12. Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Resolution for an Ordinance for Grant Lake Program at
  Grant Lake Reservoir Requesting the Los Angeles City Council to
  Establish Alternative Project Delivery Criteria Pursuant to §371(b) of the
  Los Angeles City Charter. The Ordinance will authorize a term not to exceed
  ten years.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  City Council approval is required.
